title: The agent moves the view to where its work will render
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-889 - The agent works INSIDE the app, not beside it: it reads the workspace, moves the view, and hands a Flow over (consolidation sweep 2026-09-22). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-889/plan.md.

PHASE 2, after MPI-890. Fabio, 2026-09-22: 'If the agent is going to perform something like an edit to an image, that needs to happen in the history workspace. The agent needs to change the mode from gallery to the history workspace so that the user can see the latents coming in.' Half of this already landed in MPI-877: a masked submit dispatches `{ existingGroup, scope: 'groupHistory', groupId }`, the same opts a Cue press in that workspace sends, so the latents DO draw there. They just draw in a workspace the user may not be looking at. The missing piece is only opening it. THE GUARD IS THE WHOLE JOB: never yank the view. Navigate on dispatch of work the user asked for in THAT turn, and never mid-gesture - taking the screen while they are painting a mask or dragging a composite slot is hostile. Anything else: say where it landed and let them click. Note the agent has no navigation capability today; its honest-limits list (`agentLoop.mjs:1199`) says it cannot drive the mask, paint, composite or transform tools, and navigation is a different thing from a tool - decide deliberately which side of that line it sits on and keep the limits list true either way.
